author: potuz
content: Hello, I'm reading an 8025 PR by <@688748669268132001> and have a couple of naive questions, not sure where's the right place to ask them. When verifying an envelope in an EL-less client, does the CL verify the consensus part of the envelope in full? I was wandering if there could be an edge case where the same EL payload commitment is included both in slot N, that slot comes empty, and then the next proposer picks the same block for N+1. There's RANDAO to save the day I believe for these types of edge cases, but still, from the pure EL perspective, payload can be valid if included either in N or N+1, as it only knows about its parent in N-1
